# Architecture Overview

This diagram shows a high-level architecture overview: clients -> CDN & Load Balancer -> API Gateway -> microservices running in a Kubernetes cluster, with supporting infrastructure for storage, caching, messaging, observability, and CI/CD.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  %% Clients & Edge
  subgraph Clients
    Web["Web Browser"]
    Mobile["Mobile App"]
  end

  subgraph Edge
    CDN["CDN (Static Assets)"]
    LB["Load Balancer"]
  end

  Web -->|HTTPS| CDN
  Mobile -->|HTTPS| CDN
  CDN -->|HTTP(S)| LB

  %% Ingress & API layer
  LB --> APIGW["API Gateway / Ingress"]
  APIGW --> Auth["Auth Service\n(OAuth2 / JWT)"]
  APIGW --> Router["Service Mesh / Ingress Controller"]

  %% Application services
  subgraph K8s["Kubernetes Cluster"]
    direction TB
    MS1["Service A\n(User Service)"]
    MS2["Service B\n(Order Service)"]
    MS3["Service C\n(Notification Service)"]
  end

  Router --> MS1
  Router --> MS2
  Router --> MS3

  %% Data plane
  DB["Primary DB\n(Postgres)"]
  Cache["Cache\n(Redis)"]
  MQ["Message Broker\n(Kafka / RabbitMQ)"]

  MS1 -->|reads/writes| DB
  MS2 -->|reads/writes| DB
  MS1 -->|cache| Cache
  MS2 -->|cache| Cache

  MS1 -->|produce| MQ
  MS2 -->|produce| MQ
  MQ -->|consume| MS3

  %% Observability & Logging
  Logs["Logging\n(ELK / Loki)"]
  Metrics["Monitoring\n(Prometheus & Grafana)"]
  Traces["Tracing\n(Jaeger / Tempo)"]

  MS1 --> Logs
  MS2 --> Logs
  MS3 --> Logs

  MS1 --> Metrics
  MS2 --> Metrics
  APIGW --> Traces
  MS3 --> Traces

  %% CI/CD and deployment
  CI["CI/CD\n(GitHub Actions)"] -.->|deploy| K8s

  %% External integrations
  External["3rd-party APIs\n(payment, email, SMS)"] -->|API / Webhooks| APIGW
  Identity["Identity Provider\n(Social / SSO)"] --> Auth

  %% Styling
  classDef infra fill:#f3f4f6,stroke:#999,stroke-width:1px;
  class DB,Cache,MQ,Logs,Metrics,Traces,CI,K8s infra;
